home.metaTitle: Renvura — Child development & play-based learning materials
home.metaDescription: Renvura is a child-development and play-based learning brand for Bangladesh, curated by a specialist with fifteen years in early childhood development and inclusive education.
home.headline: Every toy here earns its place.
home.subline: Materials selected for how they help a child grow — not for how fast they sell.
home.curatorCredentials: M.Ed., Institute of Education and Research, University of Dhaka · 15 years in early childhood care and development and inclusive education
home.principleCurationBody: Every item is selected by a child-development professional, on the basis of what supports a child's growth.
home.principleGuidanceBody: The catalogue is organised by age range and by development domain — fine motor, language and literacy, logic and maths, social-emotional, and STEM.
home.principleLanguageBody: The whole site reads in both languages, and the expert note on each item is written in Bangla first.
home.statusBody: Product listings, expert notes and ordering are still in build. This page is the foundation of the site — nothing here is a live product offer. If you have a question in the meantime, please get in touch.

about.metaDescription: Renvura is founded by Abdullah Al Masum, a child-development professional with an M.Ed. from the Institute of Education and Research, University of Dhaka.
about.title: About Renvura
about.lead: Renvura is a child-development and play-based learning brand for Bangladesh. It is built on a simple idea: the person choosing the materials should understand how children actually learn.
about.founderBody: Renvura is founded by Abdullah Al Masum, a child-development professional with fifteen years of work in early childhood care and development and in inclusive education. He holds an M.Ed. from the Institute of Education and Research at the University of Dhaka.
about.approachBody: Renvura is expertise-first. Guidance comes before the sale: material is organised by the age it suits and by the skill it builds, and each item carries a note explaining what it helps a child practise. The focus is early childhood, with the range extending through age twelve.
about.buildBody: This site is in active build. The brand foundation, both languages and the contact route are live. The catalogue, ordering and the expert journal are being built in sequence and will open as each is ready.
